answer: Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 54 epochs of grading, and every jetty settlement recomputes the signal schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 54 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
